high_level_description: This image is a social media post from an Instagram account named "young_hindu." The post features two photographs of the Somnath Temple, a significant Hindu temple located on the western coast of India. The top photograph shows the ruins of the temple, with the text "Razed 17 times" overlaid. This indicates that the temple has been destroyed multiple times throughout history. The ruins appear to be ancient, with stone structures and intricate carvings, suggesting a rich historical background.
